description: Complete Admin features in admin-frontend: dashboard with real-time KPIs + SLA monitoring, approvals with private identity reveal + verification notes, **CORE FLOW**: admin order arrangement (GET /admin/requests exposes wholesaler name → POST /admin/orders/:id/arrange assigns courier), order orchestration (cancel/refund), live inventory with supplier names + IMEI tracking (decrypted admin-only), dispatch with matching simulation, disputes with resolution workflow. CRITICAL: admin UI MUST show supplier names, buyer names, GST, IMEI (full private identity layer).
steps: Enhance Dashboard in /Users/mac/freeLancing/salebysale/salebysale-admin-frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx: add auto-refresh every 30 seconds (setInterval); add SLA monitoring card: fetch GET /admin/orders, filter by status 'assigned' or 'picked', calculate how many are past ETA (order.sla.etaMax < now); display 'X orders past ETA' in red badge

**CORE FEATURE**: Add admin order arrangement flow to AdminOrders in /Users/mac/freeLancing/salebysale/salebysale-admin-frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx: (a) Add 'Pending Arrangement' tab; fetch GET /admin/requests (returns orders with status 'awaiting_admin' or 'reserved', exposes wholesaler: {shopName, gst, area, address, phone} and retailer: {name, shopName, phone, area, address}); (b) Display table: Retailer | Wholesaler | Mobile | Qty | Landed Price | ETA | Actions; (c) 'Arrange Courier' button → modal with rider dropdown (fetch GET /admin/riders, filter dutyOn: true); select rider → call POST /admin/orders/:id/arrange {riderId} → order status 'assigned', shipment created; (d) Show success message: 'Courier <rider.name> assigned to pick up from <wholesaler.shopName>'

Enhance AdminOrders with order orchestration: add action column to All Orders table: Cancel button (POST /orders/:id/cancel {reason}), Refund button (placeholder alert 'Refund workflow TBD'); add status filter dropdown (all, awaiting_admin, assigned, picked, delivered, disputed, cancelled); render o.buyerId.name AND o.supplierId.shopName in table (admin privilege)

Enhance AdminStock in /Users/mac/freeLancing/salebysale/salebysale-admin-frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx: render i.supplierId.shopName in table; add 'View IMEI' button per row (enabled only if order exists for inventoryId); on click, find orderId linked to inventoryId, call GET /admin/imei/:orderId → modal shows masked IMEI, full IMEI (decrypted, admin-only), serial, scanEvents timeline; add stock verification prompts: if lastVerifiedAt > 4 hours ago, show yellow 'Stale' badge; 'Request verification' button → PATCH /supplier/inventory/:id {verify: true} (or just display 'Verification requested' message)

Enhance Dispatch in /Users/mac/freeLancing/salebysale/salebysale-admin-frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx: add 'Simulate match' section for pending packing orders: calculate distance from supplier to buyer (haversine formula with lat/lng or display raw coords); show recommended rider based on dutyOn: true + closest to supplier + reliability score (hardcode or use user.reliability); display match score (0-100) next to each rider in dropdown

Enhance Disputes in /Users/mac/freeLancing/salebysale/salebysale-admin-frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx: add action buttons per dispute: 'Approve refund' (update dispute status to 'refund_approved'; backend may need endpoint), 'Reject' (status 'rejected'), 'Escalate' (status 'escalated'); add notes textarea for each action; add status filter (open, refund_approved, rejected, escalated)

findings:
